finalists.label: Cysticercosis
finalists.why: It has specific findings such as a nodule on the lateral tongue and no evidence against it.

finalists.label: Lymphoma
finalists.why: It explains the presence of multiple asymptomatic nodules despite the lack of lymphadenopathy and systemic symptoms.

frontier_selector.why: The presence of a firm, non-tender nodule on the lateral tongue is a distinctive finding that strongly supports Cysticercosis.
